global_style: dark fantasy painterly realism grounded in the material culture of Valoria
weathered practical fabrics, iron, leather and restrained abyssal motifs
cinematic chiaroscuro, muted earth palette with controlled supernatural accents
pose_constraints: anatomically plausible grounded pose with coherent center of gravity
natural spine, neck and joint alignment
exactly two coherent arms and two coherent legs when visible, without duplicated anatomy
hands proportionate to framing and weapon grips mechanically correct
spatially consistent interaction, no extreme contortion, impossible perspective, aggressive foreshortening or disconnected limbs

epic_poses.defensive_stance: grounded defensive stance, balanced feet and guarded torso
epic_poses.grounded_advance: measured forward advance with weight over the leading foot
epic_poses.ritual_focus: stable ritual posture with relaxed shoulders and deliberate hands
epic_poses.aftermath_stillness: quiet upright stillness after conflict, natural fatigue

race_anchors.Humano: human diversity, weathered and historically grounded
race_anchors.Elfo: Valorian elven features, restrained otherworldliness, practical silhouette
race_anchors.Anão: compact robust silhouette, crafted metal and stone traditions

class_anchors.Devoto do Abismo: protective silhouette, ritual scars and a deliberate relationship with danger
class_anchors.Sangromante: precise blood-contract symbolism, controlled risk, never graphic gore
class_anchors.Corruptor: decay as material process, organic or mineral motifs without body horror excess
class_anchors.Arcanista Cinzento: improvised ether instrumentation, ash, copper and calibrated light
class_anchors.Médico de Campo: field medicine, practical instruments, stained but non-graphic working layers
